records.source: The constants: ``MAD_SCALE`` is ``1 / Phi^-1(0.75)`` = 1.4826, which makes the MAD of a normal sample estimate its standard deviation. B-scores use R's rounded factor 1.4826 to match cellHTS2. ``SSMD_ESTIMATORS`` are ``mm`` (method of moments), ``umvue`` (uniformly minimal variance unbiased) and ``robust`` (median/MAD, SSMD*). ``DEFAULT_HIT_THRESHOLDS`` are 3 for every statistic: SSMD 3 is Zhang's "strong" effect, and 3 robust sigma is the usual cut-off for robust z and the B-score. ``MEDIAN_POLISH_MAX_ITER`` and ``MEDIAN_POLISH_EPS`` are R's ``medpolish`` defaults (10 and 0.01) for general median polish. B-scores use cellHTS2's tighter stopping settings: 200 iterations and a tolerance of 1e-5.

records.translation: Fastarnir: ``MAD_SCALE`` er ``1 / Phi^-1(0.75)`` = 1.4826, sem lætur MAD normaldreifðs úrtaks meta staðalfrávik þess. B-skor nota námundaða stuðulinn 1.4826 úr R til að samsvara cellHTS2. ``SSMD_ESTIMATORS`` eru ``mm`` (vægisaðferð), ``umvue`` (óbjagaður með jafnt lágmarksdreifni) og ``robust`` (miðgildi/MAD, SSMD*). ``DEFAULT_HIT_THRESHOLDS`` er 3 fyrir hverja tölfræði: SSMD 3 eru "strong" áhrif samkvæmt Zhang, og 3 traust sigma eru venjuleg mörk fyrir robust z og B-skorið. ``MEDIAN_POLISH_MAX_ITER`` og ``MEDIAN_POLISH_EPS`` eru sjálfgildi ``medpolish`` í R (10 og 0.01) fyrir almenna miðgildissléttun. B-skor nota strangari stöðvunarskilyrði cellHTS2: 200 ítranir og vikmörk 1e-5.
